standalone_dummy_reason: A national month-level indicator is exactly collinear with calendar-month fixed effects.
official_core_interval_interpretation: Monthly sensitivity interval from the first extraordinary-situation month through the last complete month before the special situation ended on 1 April 2022; it is not a claim that restrictions or tourism effects were constant.
foreign_share_measurement_guardrail: The municipality characteristic must be measured before both its own first accessible Magic Pass exposure and the pandemic, and before the focal cohort anchor.
baseline_cutoff_definition: Earliest of focal cohort month, municipality first-exposure month at 120 minutes when any, and 2020-03-01; the baseline ends one month before this cutoff.

legacy_broad_interval_secondary_sensitiv.interpretation: Preserved only to compare with earlier project outputs; not treated as the official chronology.
